tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Watch background, every screen. Never pure black except High contrast.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised areas: list rows, cards, overlays.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, selected/pressed rows, chart tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and ring tracks only; never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and live numbers without a grade.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, units, labels. Readable (≥4.5:1) on bg and surface.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Disabled text and placeholders only; never carries information the user must read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Controls only: primary button fill, focus ring, progress arcs, chart line. Never colours a number, a status word or a grade, so it can never be mistaken for a grading colour.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: System status: confirmed, connected, saved. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: status-caution
tokens.usage: System status: caution, approaching a limit, stale data. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: System status: error, critical alert, destructive action. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: System status: informational. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: grade-far
tokens.usage: Approved performance grade 'far off' (fixed, theme-independent). Live metrics only.

tokens.name: grade-adjust
tokens.usage: Approved performance grade 'adjust' (fixed). Live metrics only.

tokens.name: grade-on
tokens.usage: Approved performance grade 'on target' (fixed). Live metrics only.

tokens.name: grade-achieved
tokens.usage: Approved performance grade 'achieved' (fixed). Live metrics only.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Documentation backdrop behind watch previews only. Not part of the watch UI.

tokens.name: bezel
tokens.usage: Physical bezel ring drawn around previews. Not part of the watch UI.

styles.name: display-bike
styles.usage: Bike Mode lead metric only (power or pace). To validate at riding distance (test S1).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Wrist lead metric and digital clock (approved v2 size).

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Rep count, rest countdown, single-value panels.

styles.name: metric-s
styles.usage: Wrist secondary metrics and tile values.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page heading, one line. Longer titles use a short display name.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text, at most two lines on a screen.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels. One or two words from the controlled vocabulary.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels and units beside numbers.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Floor size. Source, age and legal text only; never essential information.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudge.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Label to its number.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Between related elements; list row inner gap.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Between groups; button internal side padding minimum.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Between buttons; button side padding.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Section separation on scrolling pages.

tokens.name: safe-radius
tokens.usage: Round-screen safe circle (120 px radius minus 6 px edge padding). All text and controls inside.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Chips and small status tags.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: List rows, cards, banners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons (pill), steppers.

size.note: Interaction sizes at 240 × 240 (1 px ≈ 0.135 mm on the 32.5 mm panel).

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target in any direction (≈ 5.9 mm).

tokens.name: button-h
tokens.usage: Standard button height.

tokens.name: button-h-bike
tokens.usage: Bike Mode button height (gloves, vibration).

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: List row height.

tokens.name: control-gap
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between two adjacent touch targets.

duration.note: Motion tokens. Reduced Motion replaces all of them with 0ms cross-fades.

tokens.name: motion-instant
tokens.usage: Reduced Motion, live metric updates.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Pressed state, selection, chip appear.

tokens.name: motion-standard
tokens.usage: Page change, overlay open/close.

tokens.name: motion-emphasis
tokens.usage: One-time arc fill on wake (≤ 400 ms, approved v2 rule).
